auth.description:
To get your Personal Access Token (PAT):

1. Go to **Azure DevOps** and click your profile icon (top-right)
2. Select **Personal access tokens**
3. Click **+ New Token**
4. Give it a name and set expiration
5. Under **Scopes**, select:
   - **Work Items**: Read & Write
   - **Project and Team**: Read
6. Click **Create** and copy the token (you won't see it again)

**Organization URL** is your Azure DevOps URL, e.g. `https://dev.azure.com/mycompany`
auth.props.organizationUrl.description: Your Azure DevOps organization URL (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/mycompany)
auth.props.pat.description: Your Azure DevOps PAT with Work Items (Read & Write) and Project and Team (Read) scopes.

triggers.new_updated_work_item.descripti: Polls Azure DevOps every few minutes and fires when a work item is created or updated. Use this when your Activepieces instance is not reachable from the public internet; otherwise prefer the Instant trigger. Pick a work item type to unlock the state filter.
triggers.new_updated_work_item.props.sta: Filter by state. Leave empty to trigger for all states.
triggers.new_updated_work_item.props.wor: Filter by work item type. Leave empty to trigger for all types.
triggers.new_updated_work_item_webhook.d: Fires instantly when a work item is created, updated, or commented on in Azure DevOps via a Service Hooks subscription. Requires a public webhook URL reachable from Azure DevOps.
triggers.new_updated_work_item_webhook.p: Which work item lifecycle events should trigger this flow. Select at least one.
Filter by work item type. Leave empty to trigger for all types.
